parsedVerdict.reasoning: TicketController fits the presentation layer. It defines request body shapes (BuyBody, ScanBody) and passes each request to the business services BoxOffice and GateLog. The file sets no prices, checks no seat availability and decides nothing about who gets admitted. It also does no persistence and no framework wiring. The only judgement call is in scan(): it calls admit() and then gates.scanned(). That is two delegating calls run in order, not a business rule. Each decision stays inside the business services.
